body:
Builds discussion #600.

## Problem

Drawing tools on the diagram canvas (line/rectangle/ellipse/polygon shapes, free text) always start from the same fixed default style. If you draw a line and change it to blue, the next line you draw is still black — you have to reapply the same color/width/font change to every new item, even within the same editing session.

## What exists today

- **Shapes** (`QetShapeItem`): created in `DiagramEventAddShape::mousePressEvent` with a plain default-constructed `QPen()`/`QBrush()` (black, width 1, `Qt::NoBrush`) — nothing read from anywhere.
- **Free text** (`IndependentTextItem`): font comes from `QETApp::indiTextsItemFont()`, a static app-wide Preferences setting, not a live "last used" value. Text color is hardcoded and has no UI control at all.
- No existing "remember last used" mechanism anywhere in the codebase (grepped for `lastUsed`, `defaultColor`, `defaultPen`, etc.) — editing an item's style through the property editors only pushes an undo command onto that item's own undo stack; it never affects what the next new item gets.

## Change

Added `LastUsedStyle` (`sources/lastusedstyle.{h,cpp}`): a small, in-memory, session-scoped static helper — deliberately **not** `QSettings`-backed, since this is a live "what did I just use" value for the current session, not a new persisted app-wide default (that's already the existing Preferences font setting, kept as the fallback).

Two hook points per item type:
- **Write side**: `ShapeGraphicsItemPropertiesWidget::associatedUndo()` — captures the new pen/brush right where an undo command is actually pushed. Covers both code paths that can edit a single shape: the live-edit properties dock, and the modal dialog opened by `QetShapeItem::editProperty()` (right-click → edit). `IndiTextPropertiesWidget::on_m_font_pb_clicked()` — captures the font right after `QFontDialog::getFont()` returns.
- **Read side**: `DiagramEventAddShape::mousePressEvent`, right after constructing a new shape — applies the stored pen/brush if one exists this session. `IndependentTextItem`'s constructor — uses the stored font if set, else falls back to `QETApp::indiTextsItemFont()` exactly as before.

## Why this shape

Keeping it in-memory rather than `QSettings`-backed matches the reported behavior exactly ("subsequent lines drawn will also be blue," within the session) without opening the separate question of what a persisted-across-restarts default should look like relative to the existing Preferences font default. Doesn't touch the undo/redo system at all — the property editors keep working exactly as they do now, this just adds a side-effect write next to the existing `apply()` call.

## Not in scope (per discussion)

- Last-used text color — no color control exists in the text properties UI to originate the value from yet; worth a follow-up if that control is added.
- Persisting last-used style across app restarts.
- The element/symbol editor's own drawing tools (`sources/editor/`) — a separate subsystem from diagram-canvas annotations.

## Test plan

- [x] Full project builds and links clean (`cmake --build`, default `BUILD_WITH_KF5=ON` config), zero new warnings in any touched/new file
- [ ] Manual: draw a shape, change its color/width in the properties dock, draw a new shape of the same type, confirm it starts with the just-used style; same for free text and font
- [ ] Manual: same check via the modal shape-properties dialog (right-click → edit) instead of the dock

commits.messageBody:
Drawing tools on the diagram canvas always started new shapes and free
text from a fixed hardcoded default (Qt's plain QPen()/QBrush(), and
the static Preferences font) -- changing a shape's color or a text's
font had zero effect on what the next new item of that type got, even
within the same editing session.

Add LastUsedStyle: a small in-memory, session-scoped static helper
(no QSettings, no persistence across restarts -- this is a live "what
did I just use" value, not a new app-wide default). Write side hooks
capture the value right where the properties editors already apply a
change (ShapeGraphicsItemPropertiesWidget::associatedUndo(), both the
live-edit dock path and the modal editProperty() dialog path; and
IndiTextPropertiesWidget::on_m_font_pb_clicked() right after the font
dialog returns). Read side hooks apply the stored value, if any, to a
newly created item: DiagramEventAddShape::mousePressEvent for shapes,
IndependentTextItem's constructor for free text (falling back to the
existing QETApp::indiTextsItemFont() Preferences default otherwise).

Doesn't touch the element/symbol editor's own drawing tools (a
separate subsystem) or add last-used text color (no color control
exists in the text properties UI to originate it from yet).
commits.messageHeadline: Remember last-used shape/text style for new items this session

title: Remember last-used shape/text style for new items this session
